0 AS favorited
FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.id = #{dishId} AND d.deleted = 0

SELECT , 1 AS favorited FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dish_favorite f WHERE f.dish_id = d.id AND f.user_id = #{userId})

SELECT d.id, d.stall_id, d.name, d.price, d.category, d.image, d.description, d.featured, d.status, d.stock_qty, d.sold_out, d.create_time, s.name AS stall_name, s.window_no AS window_no, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS avg_rating, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS review_count, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating >= #{goodThreshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS good_rate, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ds.quantity), 0) FROM dish_sales ds WHERE ds.dish_id = d.id) AS sales_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dish_ad ad WHERE ad.dish_id = d.id AND ad.deleted = 0 AND ad.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (ad.start_time IS NULL OR ad.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ad.end_time IS NULL OR ad.end_time >= NOW())) AS is_ad, (SELECT ad2.id FROM dish_ad ad2 WHERE ad2.dish_id = d.id AND ad2.deleted = 0 AND ad2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (ad2.start_time IS NULL OR ad2.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ad2.end_time IS NULL OR ad2.end_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY ad2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS ad_id, 0 AS favorited FROM dish d LEFT JOIN canteen_stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN dish_review r ON r.dish_id = d.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND d.id <> #{dishId}
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

ORDER BY d.featured DESC, avg_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
